cards.name: Glacier Racer
cards.text: Spellburst: Deal 3 damage to all Frozen enemies.
cards.flavorText: It’s just not the same without a super suit.

cards.name: Glade Ecologist
cards.text: Deathrattle: Get a 1-Cost Holy spell that gives a minion +2 or -2 Health.
cards.flavorText: The dude minored in Underfel Biology. Now that's a renaissance Tortollan!

cards.name: Gladesong Siren
cards.text: Lifesteal Costs (1) if you've cast a Holy and Shadow spell this turn.
cards.flavorText: When she shifts into minor key she really throws the void-holy balance out of whack.

cards.name: Gladiator's Longbow
cards.text: Your hero is Immune while attacking.
cards.flavorText: The longbow allows shots to be fired from farther away and is useful for firing on particularly odorous targets.

cards.name: Gladiatorial Combat
cards.text: Summon a random minion from your deck. Summon a 5/5 Tiger with Stealth for your opponent.
cards.flavorText: I could win this fight with one head tied behind my back!

cards.name: Glaivebound Adept
cards.text: Battlecry: If your hero attacked this turn, deal 4 damage.
cards.flavorText: "Initiate, this is your glaive. Think of it as an extension of yourself... Did you just throw it?!"

cards.name: Glaiveshark
cards.text: Battlecry: If your hero attacked this turn, deal 2 damage to all enemies.
cards.flavorText: Can smell a drop of vengeance in the water up to a mile away.

cards.name: Glaivetar
cards.text: Deathrattle: Draw (card, cards). (Play Outcast cards while equipped to improve!)
cards.flavorText: Might need tuning, I think it's a bit sharp.

cards.name: Glaivezooka
cards.text: Battlecry: Give a random friendly minion +1 Attack.
cards.flavorText: For the times when a regular bazooka just isn't enough.

cards.name: Glide
cards.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Draw 4 cards. Outcast: Your opponent does the same.
cards.flavorText: "Come with me, and you'll see, a whole new hand of possibly the same cards."

cards.name: Glinda Crowskin
cards.text: Minions in your hand have Echo.
cards.flavorText: Summon an unlimited* number of minions!** *Six **Wisps

cards.name: Glitter Moth
cards.text: Battlecry: If your deck has only odd-Cost cards, double the Health of your other minions.
cards.flavorText: Some moths are attracted to flame. This one's attracted to disco.

cards.name: Gloom Stag
cards.text: Taunt Battlecry: If your deck has only odd-Cost cards, gain +2/+2.
cards.flavorText: Majestic. Ethereal. Still pretty down in the dumps, though.

cards.name: Gloomstone Guardian
cards.text: Taunt. Choose One - Discard 2 cards; or Destroy one of your Mana Crystals. Forge: Do NEITHER.
cards.flavorText: From the same people who brought you Choose One, and Choose Twice, comes the exciting prequel: Choose NEITHER!

cards.name: Gloop Sprayer
cards.text: Battlecry: Summon a copy of each adjacent minion.
cards.flavorText: "Are you sure that's enough gloop?" "Hold on."

cards.name: Glory Chaser
cards.text: After you play a Taunt minion, draw a card.
cards.flavorText: When you've reached the peak of competition twice, how hard can winning one valley be?

cards.name: Glow-Tron
cards.text: Magnetic
cards.flavorText: They tried for weeks to make a stealth version, but eventually decided to just let it glow.

cards.name: Glowfly Swarm
cards.text: Summon a 2/2 Glowfly for each spell in your hand.
cards.flavorText: Glowflies are distant relations to spelling bees.

cards.name: Glowroot Lure
cards.text: Taunt. Costs (1) less for each time you used your Hero Power this game.
cards.flavorText: You'd think this is a creation of the Emerald Nightmare, but you would be wrong.

cards.name: Glowstone Gyreworm
cards.text: Lifesteal Quickdraw: Deal 5 damage. Forge: Change Quickdraw to Battlecry.
cards.flavorText: Believe it or not, this is Tram Conductor Gerry's Gyreworm. But is it pronounced Gerry's Gyreworm, Gerry's Gyreworm, Gerry's Gyreworm, or Gerry's Gyreworm?

cards.name: Glowstone Technician
cards.text: Battlecry: Give all minions in your hand +2/+2.
cards.flavorText: "Windell! More light!" "I'm givin' it all she's got, Kangor!"

cards.name: Glugg the Gulper
cards.text: Colossal +3 After a friendly minion dies, gain its original stats.
cards.flavorText: Food can be scarce in the Abyssal Depths, leading its top predators to pursue any potential source of sustenance. Even extra crunchy ones.

cards.name: Gluttonous Ooze
cards.text: Battlecry: Destroy your opponent's weapon and gain Armor equal to its Attack.
cards.flavorText: Three time winner of the Un'Goro weapon eating contest.

cards.name: Gnash
cards.text: Give your hero +3 Attack this turn. Gain 3 Armor.
cards.flavorText: It's rude to gnash with your mouth open.

cards.name: Gnawing Greenfin
cards.text: Battlecry: Get a random Murloc.
cards.flavorText: "Are you eating bark again!?" "Gnawwwww...."

cards.name: Gnome Muncher
cards.text: Taunt, Lifesteal At the end of your turn,& attack the lowest Health enemy.
cards.flavorText: Gnom gnom gnom.

cards.name: Gnome Private
cards.text: Honorable Kill: Gain +2 Attack.
cards.flavorText: She's doing her part.

cards.name: Gnomeferatu
cards.text: Battlecry: Remove the top card of your opponent's deck.
cards.flavorText: She prefers the term "Glampire."

cards.name: Gnomeferatu
cards.text: Battlecry:& Remove the top card of your opponent's deck.
cards.flavorText: She prefers the term "Glampire."

cards.name: Gnomelia, S.A.F.E. Pilot
cards.text: Rush. Also damages minions next to whomever this attacks. Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to all enemies.
cards.flavorText: Never learned how to L.A.N.D.

cards.name: Gnomeregan Infantry
cards.text: Charge Taunt
cards.flavorText: The gnomes are valiant and ready to return to their irradiated, poorly ventilated homeland!

cards.name: Gnomish Experimenter
cards.text: Battlecry: Draw a card. If it's a minion, transform it into a Chicken.
cards.flavorText: He's legitimately surprised every time he turns himself into a chicken.

cards.name: Gnomish Inventor
cards.text: Battlecry: Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: She's never quite sure what she's making, she just knows it's AWESOME!

cards.name: Go with the Flow
cards.text: Choose a minion. If it's an enemy, Freeze it. If it's friendly, give it Spell Damage +1.
cards.flavorText: Just go with the flow, bro! No mo' woe fo' yo'!

cards.name: Goblin Auto-Barber
cards.text: Battlecry: Give your weapon +1 Attack.
cards.flavorText: This guy is excellent at adjusting your haircut and/or height.

cards.name: Goblin Blastmage
cards.text: Battlecry: If you control a Mech, deal 6 damage randomly split among all enemies.
cards.flavorText: If you can't find a bomb to throw, just pick up any goblin invention and throw that.

cards.name: Goblin Blastmage
cards.text: Battlecry: If you control a Mech, deal 6 damage randomly split among all enemies.
cards.flavorText: If you can't find a bomb to throw, just pick up any goblin invention and throw that.

cards.name: Goblin Bomb
cards.text: Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
cards.flavorText: They're Dr. Boom's babies. His baby boomers.

cards.name: Goblin Prank
cards.text: Give a friendly minion +3/+3 and Rush. It dies at end of turn.
cards.flavorText: "Ha ha! Glork looks ridiculous! ...Glork? Glork?"

cards.name: Goblin Sapper
cards.text: Has +4 Attack while your opponent has 6 or more cards in hand.
cards.flavorText: He’s not such a binge exploder anymore. These days, he only explodes socially.

cards.name: Goboglide Tech
cards.text: Battlecry: If you control a Mech, gain +1/+1 and Rush.
cards.flavorText: The word "glide" is always in quotes in the manual.

cards.name: Godfather Kazakus
cards.text: Battlecry: Plot a custom sham trial! Then choose the trial's length.
cards.flavorText: There was a good reason the gangs of Gadgetzan never worked together. It was Kazakus who planned the heist… but it was always going to be Blackpaw who took the fall.

cards.name: Godfrey the Betrayer
cards.text: Start of Game: Overdrawn cards return to your hand when you have space. They cost (1) less.
cards.flavorText: Hunted down and cornered in Shadowfang Keep, Godfrey was left with no choice but to go quietly. But before his time is up, that monster, Crowley, will get what’s coming to him.

cards.name: Going Down Swinging
cards.text: Give your hero +2 Attack and Immune this turn, then attack each enemy minion.
cards.flavorText: Halveria was outcast from Gilneas for being too edgy, which she sees as an achievement.

cards.name: Golakka Crawler
cards.text: Battlecry: Destroy a Pirate and gain +1/+1.
cards.flavorText: Universally adored by both control decks and ninjas.

cards.name: Golakka Glutton
cards.text: Battlecry: Destroy a Beast and gain +1/+1.
cards.flavorText: We lost our last cook to one of these.

cards.name: Gold Panner
cards.text: At the end of your turn, draw a card.
cards.flavorText: "I don't know why everyone's got their overalls in a jumble with Azerite minin' when there's all this GOLD for the takin'!"

cards.name: Gold Road Grunt
cards.text: Taunt Frenzy: Gain Armor equal to the damage taken.
cards.flavorText: No, no, no, Gold Roads are very different from Yellow Brick Roads.

cards.name: Golden Scarab
cards.text: Battlecry: Discover a 4-Cost card.
cards.flavorText: Who actually puts all the gold plating on these things, and why?

cards.name: Goldpetal Drake
cards.text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Imbue your Hero Power.
cards.flavorText: All that glitters is gold... Petal. Drake.

cards.name: Goldrinn
cards.text: Rush Friendly Beasts deal double damage.
cards.flavorText: His relentless ferocity has made him well known among many peoples and by many names, including Lo’Gosh and the Great Wolf.

cards.name: Goldshire Footman
cards.text: Taunt
cards.flavorText: If 1/2 minions are all that is defending Goldshire, you would think it would have been overrun years ago.

cards.name: Goldshire Gnoll
cards.text: Rush Costs (1) less for each other card in your hand.
cards.flavorText: They're searching for one ring. They're pretty sure someone said Goldshire.

cards.name: Goldwing
cards.text: Rush Battlecry: If you're holding a Mech, gain Windfury.
cards.flavorText: This HAS to be worth more dust, right?

cards.name: Golganneth, the Thunderer
cards.text: Titan Your first spell each turn costs (3) less.
cards.flavorText: With dominion over the seas and skies, Golganneth fearlessly wields the power of nature to serve the Pantheon.

cards.name: Goliath, Sneed's Masterpiece
cards.text: Battlecry: Fire five rockets at enemy minions that deal 2 damage each. (You pick the targets!)
cards.flavorText: “Listen, this baby has blades, rockets, and rocket blades. Only thing it doesn’t have is good gas mileage.”

cards.name: Gone Fishin'
cards.text: Dredge. Combo: Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: Rogues want me Fish fear me

cards.name: Gonk, the Raptor
cards.text: After your hero attacks and kills a minion, it may attack again.
cards.flavorText: There’s a word for Zandalari druids who refuse to pledge loyalty to Gonk: “Delicious.”

cards.name: Goody Two-Shields
cards.text: Divine Shield Spellburst: Gain Divine Shield.
cards.flavorText: These are my shields. There are at least two like them, and both are mine.

cards.name: Gorehowl
cards.text: Attacking a minion costs 1 Attack instead of 1 Durability.
cards.flavorText: Grommash Hellscream's famous axe. Somehow this ended up in Prince Malchezaar's possession. Quite the mystery!

cards.name: Gorgonzormu
cards.text: Battlecry: Get a 2-Cost Cheese that summons three 1-Cost minions. It upgrades each turn.
cards.flavorText: Don't remove this from your deck or else you'll be cutting the cheese.

cards.name: Gorillabot A-3
cards.text: Battlecry: If you control another Mech, Discover a Mech.
cards.flavorText: A-1 and A-2 went nuts, when they should have gone bolts.

cards.name: Gorillabot A-3
cards.text: Battlecry: If you control another Mech,& Discover a Mech.
cards.flavorText: A-1 and A-2 went nuts, when they should have gone bolts.

cards.name: Gorishi Tunneler
cards.text: Stealth After this attacks,& deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
cards.flavorText: "This card is really boring." "Nah, I really dig this card."

cards.name: Gorishi Wasp
cards.text: Rush. Whenever this takes damage,& get a 1-Cost Gorishi Stinger.
cards.flavorText: This card is the wasp's elbows!
